title: Why Bananas Are Still So Cheap

scenes.narration: Have you noticed how expensive your grocery bill has become lately?

visual.text: Why Bananas Are Still So Cheap

scenes.narration: Since the year 2000, overall grocery prices in the US have skyrocketed by 95%.
Yet, during that exact same period, banana prices increased by only 34%.
This fruit has essentially defied the massive inflation seen elsewhere.
The full story is on the channel.

title: The Strange Price of White Bread

scenes.narration: Why has the price of a simple loaf of bread more than doubled?

visual.text: The Strange Price of White Bread

scenes.narration: In January 2000, a pound of white bread cost just $0.91.
By October 2026, that same loaf reached an average of $1.86.
That is an increase of 105% over the last quarter century.
The full story is on the channel.

title: Are Bananas Actually Frozen in Time?

scenes.narration: How stable is the price of your favorite tropical fruit?

visual.text: Are Bananas Actually Frozen in Time?

scenes.narration: Bananas hit a record high of just $0.67 in September 2025.
Since January 2010, banana prices have risen only 12%.
Compare that to the 50% jump in overall grocery costs.
The full story is on the channel.
